Container.Name: plex-librarian-discovery
Container.Overview: Optional host discovery for Plex Librarian. Fresh installations share the private transport volume automatically; no path entry is needed. Install one helper per host, then Enable host discovery in Librarian's Media connections. Docker socket access is host-administrator-equivalent despite the read-only mount. Exposes only authenticated mount and endpoint evidence on a private Unix socket. No media mounts. Release preparation: the referenced image and Community Applications listing must be published before public installation is available. Existing bind-based discovery installations must preserve their original transport directory and pairing key.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Helper-only Docker API access; never add this to Librarian.
